# CtrLoop

> CtrLoop builds AI workers - Bea (data), Otto (intelligence) and Dash (action) - that turn data into action for sales, operations, finance and support teams. First for consumer brands, travel and hospitality, and financial services. Humans keep the gate.

Offices: Bangalore, Seattle, Dubai. Contact: support@ctrloop.ai. Careers: careers@ctrloop.ai.

## Pages

- [CtrLoop | AI Workers for Sales, Ops & Support](https://ctrloop.ai/): AI workers that turn data into action for consumer brands, travel and financial services. Data, intelligence and action - with humans at the gate.
- [AI Workforce Platform - Data, Intelligence, Action | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/platform): One loop that senses, decides, acts and learns - with guardrails, approvals and a full audit trail.
- [Bea - AI Data Collection Worker | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/crew/bea): Bea connects to every system and source - inside your business and out - and keeps one live, clean picture of it.
- [Otto - AI Analyst & Market Intelligence Worker | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/crew/otto): Otto looks across all your data, makes the strategic call, and hands it to Dash - or to you, when it matters.
- [Dash - AI Execution Worker | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/crew/dash): Dash turns decisions into done - email, WhatsApp and updates in your systems - and follows up until it's finished.
- [AI Workers for Consumer Brands & Quick Commerce | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/industries/consumer-brands): Track rivals, fix listings and reprice across Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce - without growing the team.
- [Hotel Rate Intelligence & OTA Rate Parity Tracking | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/industries/travel-hospitality): Pricing, availability and ranking from every OTA and Google Hotels - collected, matched and delivered as one clean feed.
- [AI Workers for Banks, NBFCs & Co-operatives | CtrLoop](https://ctrloop.ai/industries/financial-services): Customer calling, data, underwriting and collections for banks, NBFCs and co-operatives. Coming soon - now taking design partners.
- [About CtrLoop - Ex-Amazon Founders Building the AI Workforce](https://ctrloop.ai/company): Ex-Amazon AI and consumer tech leaders building AI workers for teams worldwide. Partnerships, team and contact.
- [Careers](https://ctrloop.ai/careers): Open roles at CtrLoop.
